{{Top|leg}}
'''Admiral of the Coreworlds''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] reserved for those [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] in charge of their respective [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planetary [[Navy/Legends|navies]]. Since these admirals were in service to their own respective governments their authority extended only to ships operating within their local sectors. It was not uncommon for some [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] admirals to declare that they had no [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in order to avoid this position, such that they could continue to serve in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and compete for the rank of [[Admiral of the Fleet/Legends|Admiral of the Fleet]].
